snippet.title: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Two musicians from the Netherlands spent 3 years making an indie game where everything feels improvised and all your fights get settled with frogs, and you can play it March 16th on Nintendo Switch and Steam!

THIS IS BONNIE BEAR SAVES FROGTIME 🐸🐻✨
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/bonnie-bear-saves-frogtime-switch/
Steam: https://frogtime.gg

Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger. Grab your toadbag, count those cocoduds, and explore an absurd world where every conflict is settled through Frogtime.
